description: Report the MEASURED outcome of an extension install you ran, so that 'agents can install this by themselves' becomes a count instead of a claim. Voluntary, one call, after you have checked the result with the verify step that install_extension returns — report what the profile shows, not what you intended. Stored: the day plus browser, outcome and optional version. Not stored: who called, from where, or anything else. The totals appear in adoption_stats, labelled as a lower bound because agents that do not report are absent.

outcome.description: installed = the profile confirms it; failed = you tried and the profile does not show it; skipped = you decided not to install.

version.description: Extension version found in the profile, e.g. 2.56.0.

name: report_install
